messages.subject: R workshop Sept 12-15
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!
In the week before the fall quarter begins, UC Davis Datalab is running a free four-day workshop for learning R; plus reproducible research tools like shell scripting, Git, and Github. The workshop runs 10am-3pm (with a break for lunch) on 9/12-9/15 (Monday - Thursday).

Please consider signing up, or share this notice with anyone you know who might be interested. Thanks!
-Wesley

Here is a signup link:
https://registration.genomecenter.ucdavis.edu/events/IntroToCollaborativeReproducibleResearchPracticesR/apply/

And here is a bit more information:
https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-collaborative-and-reproducible-research-practices-with-r-part-1-of-4/
